title: Optional Graphify evidence links
summary: Allow an adopter to link a Provenistem record to pinned Graphify implementation and test evidence without requiring Graphify to read or build the base catalog.
acceptance_criteria: Identify the repository, revision, source file, and exact anchor of each optional link.
Visibly distinguish source assertions, Graphify output, and run receipts.

evidence.claim: The pinned Graphify HQ kit demonstrates exact-source anchors and separate execution evidence.
